msgid: Atlanteans use logs also as the base for planks, which are used in nearly every building. Besides the sawmill, the charcoal kiln, the toolsmithy and the smokery also need logs for their work.

msgid: Planks are an important building material.

note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Planks, part 3

msgid: Spider silk is produced by spiders, which are bred by spider farms. It can be processed into spidercloth or tabards in a weaving mill, or used to make tools in the toolsmithy.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Spider Silk

msgid: Spidercloth is made out of spider silk in a weaving mill. It is used in the shipyard. Also some higher developed buildings need spidercloth for their construction.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Spidercloth

msgid: Fish is one of the biggest food resources of the Atlanteans. It has to be smoked in a smokery before being delivered to mines, training sites and scouts.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Fish

msgid: As no Atlantean likes raw fish, smoking it in a smokery is the most common way to make it edible.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Smoked Fish

msgid: Meat contains a lot of energy, and it is obtained from wild game taken by hunters.

msgid: Smoked meat is made out of meat in a smokery. It is delivered to the mines and training sites (labyrinth and dungeon) where the miners and soldiers prepare a nutritious lunch for themselves.

msgid: Water is used in the bakery and the horse and spider farms.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Water, part 2

msgid: Cornmeal is produced in a mill out of corn and is one of three parts of the Atlantean bread produced in bakeries.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Cornmeal

msgid: Blackroots are a special kind of root produced at blackroot farms and processed in mills. The Atlanteans like their strong taste and use their flour for making bread.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Blackroot

msgid: Blackroot Flour is produced in mills out of blackroots. It is used in bakeries to make a tasty bread.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Atlantean ware: Blackroot Flour

msgid: This tasty bread is made in bakeries out of cornmeal, blackroot flour and water. It is appreciated as basic food by miners, scouts and soldiers in training sites (labyrinth and dungeon).

msgid: The fires of the Barbarians are usually fed with coal. Consumers are several buildings: lime kiln, smelting works, ax workshop, war mill, and helm smithy.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Coal, part 2

msgid: It is smelted in a smelting works to retrieve the iron.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Iron Ore, part 2

msgid: It is produced by the smelting works and used to produce weapons and tools in the metal workshop, ax workshop, war mill and helm smithy.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Iron, part 2

msgid: Smelted in a smelting works, it turns into gold which is used as a precious building material and to produce weapons and armor.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Gold Ore, part 2

msgid: Only very important things are embellished with gold. It is produced by the smelting works and used as a precious building material and to produce different axes (in the war mill) and different parts of armor (in the helm smithy).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Gold, part 2

msgid: Picks are used by stonemasons and miners. They are produced in the metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Pick

msgid: Felling axes are used by lumberjacks and produced in the metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Felling Ax, part 2

msgid: Therefore the gardener and the ranger use them. Produced at the metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Shovel, part 2

msgid: Geologists, builders, blacksmiths, helmsmiths and shipwrights all need a hammer. Make sure you’ve always got some in reserve! They are one of the basic tools produced at the metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Hammer, part 2

msgid: Fishing rods are needed by fishers to catch fish.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Fishing Rod, part 1 | TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Fishing Rod, part 1

msgid: They are one of the basic tools produced in a metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Fishing Rod, part 2

msgid: This spear is light enough to be thrown, but heavy enough to kill any animal in one blow. It is only used by hunters.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Hunting Spear, part 1 | TRANSLATORS: Helptext for an Empire ware: Hunting Spear, part 1 | TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Hunting Spear, part 1

msgid: Hunting spears are produced in the metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Hunting Spear, part 2

msgid: Scythes are produced by the metal workshop (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Scythe, part 2

msgid: Bread paddles are produced in the metal workshop like all other tools (but cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Bread Paddle, part 2

msgid: Kitchen tools are needed for preparing rations, snacks and meals. Be sure to have a metal workshop to produce this basic tool (but it ceases to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Kitchen Tools
terms: preparing rations = 准备定额口粮

msgid: They are used in the smelting works and produced by the metal workshop (but they cease to be produced by the building if it is enhanced to an ax workshop and war mill).
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Fire Tongs, part 2

msgid: The ax is the basic weapon of the Barbarians. All young soldiers are equipped with it.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Ax

msgid: Young soldiers are proud to learn to fight with this powerful weapon. It is heavier and sharper than the ordinary ax. It is produced in ax workshops and war mills. In training camps, it is used – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 0 to level 1.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Sharp Ax

msgid: The broad ax is produced by the ax workshop and the war mill. It is used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers with a fundamental fighting knowledge from attack level 1 to attack level 2.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Broad Ax

msgid: The bronze ax is considered a weapon that is hard to handle. Only skilled soldiers can use it. It is produced at the war mill and used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from attack level 2 to level 3.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Bronze Ax

msgid: This is a dangerous weapon the Barbarians are able to produce. It is produced in the war mill. Only trained soldiers are able to wield such a weapon. It is used – together with food – in the training camp to train soldiers from attack level 3 to 4.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Battle Ax

msgid: The warrior’s ax is the most dangerous of all Barbarian weapons. Only a few soldiers ever were able to handle this huge and powerful ax. It is produced in a war mill and used – together with food – in a training camp to train soldiers from attack level 4 to level 5.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Warrior’s Ax

msgid: A helmet is a basic tool to protect soldiers. It is produced in the helm smithy and used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from health level 0 to level 1.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Helmet

msgid: A mask is an enhanced armor for Barbarian soldiers. It is produced in the helm smithy and used in the training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from health level 1 to level 2.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Mask

msgid: This is the most enhanced Barbarian armor. It is produced in a helm smithy and used in a training camp – together with food – to train soldiers from health level 2 to level 3.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Barbarian ware: Warhelm

note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Iron, part 2

msgid: Smelted in a furnace, it turns into gold which is used as a precious building material and to produce weapons and armor.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Gold Ore, part 2

msgid: Only very important things are embellished with gold. It is produced by the furnace and is used to produce better swords and the best helmets. The best armor is also decorated with gold.
note: TRANSLATORS: Helptext for a Frisian ware: Gold, part 2
